title: A Regiment for the Orchard
author: Juniper Villalobos
blurb: Edmund Hartwell, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the census taker asks one question too many, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
